canonical_project: Wingu Africa Tanzania (Dar es Salaam data centre + cable landing station)
notes: Wingu official page (A): launched mid-2022, 'first integrated carrier-neutral data center and cable landing station in the country', carrier-neutral colocation/interconnection/cloud-connect, Dar es Salaam (Mbezi/industrial area per press). Phase-2 expansion announced Mar 2025 (wearetech.africa B) to take facility to ~3 MW (DCD B; Anthony Voscarides LinkedIn); Empower Africa (C/B) says phase 2 completed following ~USD 50m investment. Press (wearetech) says existing facility 'certified Tier 3 by Uptime Institute'; treat certification wording with caution pending Uptime award record. Capacity 3 MW is press-reported phase-2 target.
